architecture_prior_free_claim.meaning: No named implementation architecture is required by S1/S1.1 or B1-B3; residual restrictions below remain explicit.

entries.restriction: B1-B3 use deterministic total transition/output functions and exact finite action words.
entries.justification: Needed to state the exact v1 theorem; stochastic/partial/nondeterministic variants are separate gaps.
entries.falsifier: A proof step in B1-B3 is shown to use an undeclared stronger carrier or architecture assumption.

entries.restriction: Behavioral equivalence is exact equality for all finite action suffixes.
entries.justification: Defines the v1 notion of exact behavioral identity.
entries.falsifier: The implementation or proof silently substitutes a tolerance, distribution, finite horizon, or benchmark score.

entries.restriction: Executable S1 sanity checks enumerate finite symmetric hypothesis sets only for sizes 2 through 6.
entries.justification: Bounded enumeration is only a reconstruction aid; the analytic group-action proof is unbounded.
entries.falsifier: The package advertises the bounded enumeration as the proof of S1.

entries.restriction: No environment distribution, task frequency, or real-world ecology is used in the formal theorems.
entries.justification: Prevents formal closure from being laundered into empirical capability claims.
entries.falsifier: A real-scale or ecological conclusion is claimed from this package alone.

entries.restriction: NONE in theorem admissibility: S is an abstract carrier and no neural/graph/symbolic/program topology is selected.
entries.justification: This is the narrow basis for the architecture-prior-free label.
entries.falsifier: Reconstruction requires restricting S or the quotient to a named architecture family.

entries.restriction: The deterministic theorem uses only total transition and output operators; no synthesis grammar is selected.
entries.justification: Separates generic transition structure from a grammar/library prior.
entries.falsifier: A hidden operator library beyond delta/lambda is required for the proof.
